Good attempt. Your explanation showed a good grasp of the topic, and the slide composition and content came through well and were comprehensive.

There are a few areas you can work on in your presentation delivery. Try to reduce the use of filler words so that your delivery feels smoother and more natural. Be mindful of the time you take as well, as this will help you focus on the most relevant points.
